reasons: The security-tests job was present in the baseline workflow but is missing from the current workflow.
Removing the security test gate allows the pipeline to continue without running the repository's security test suite.
The affected change is isolated to restoring one known workflow job and its dependency on the test job.
The original security test command and job configuration are available in the baseline diff, making the remediation unambiguous.
